functions.name: issue_timeline_entries
functions.description: Complete selected issue/PR timeline stream with an explicitly discriminated typed payload for all 35 pinned alternatives. Some timeline records have no stable ID and some embed comment collections; a page-spanning ordinal identifies this retrieval observation only. Unknown event discriminators fail; no event is coerced into an unrelated branch. Typed event payload branches are separate nullable detail columns with one event_types discriminator, preserving all pinned variants without widening a single transport type beyond the native column limit.
